Q1: The root-cause fix (a committed `package.json` for the action) is outside this issue's frozen edit scope. Which fix should this issue deliver?
Choices:
A. Stay inside the scope. Add a "Pin claude-pool-token action module type" step to `.github/workflows/clarify.yml` right before "Resolve Claude credential", mirroring the #7434 step in `plan.yml`: same `CLAUDE_POOL_MODULE_PIN` log prefix, no-overwrite and no-symlink write, fail-open. Add a regression test under `tests/` and a `changelog.d/` fragment. The committed `package.json`, which also covers implement, review, the poller, validate and the other callers, is left to a separately scoped issue. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Do only the root-cause fix: commit `.github/actions/claude-pool-token/package.json` (`{"type":"commonjs"}`) plus a test and a changelog fragment. This needs a trusted operator to widen the scope with an exact `files_touched` grant for that path first. Without the grant, implement will stop as `ai:scope-blocked`.
C. Do both A and B in one PR, with the same scope-grant requirement as B.
